title: Reusable reduced response of assembly.star-k2: the 1-D map eta(Pi), Pi = F/(gamma*s*r0), eta = z_apex/(s*r0), r0 = 1.0 wu
mechanism: assembly.star-k2 (composed_chain.build_star, n_rim=200 recipe, gamma=1.0 J/wu^2), solver patch-equilibrium-solver-v2, max_steps=60000

law_pins.packet_note: the packet cap max_force_N=2.0 is the PREREGISTERED law and is never widened by S3; the record's valid_loads_N rows at 2.5/3.0 N are s=1.0-only measurements above the packet cap (S0 gap 2) and are EXCLUDED from this reduced model

nodes.source: s=1.0 reference rows of load_domain_study_20261017.json (loads 0.0..2.0 N), digit-for-digit; all rows in-gate under the packet 1e-6 N law

zero_load_point.why: the zero-load cell was measured at s=1.0 only; the F=0 dilation argument (S0) is derived, not measured, off s=1.0

domain.unmeasured_gap: (0, 0.4): between the zero-load cell and the measured matched-Pi invariance window; refused

interpolation.scheme: Fritsch-Carlson monotone cubic Hermite (PCHIP-equivalent, shape-preserving; overshoot impossible on the strictly monotone node table)
interpolation.endpoint_rule: scipy-compatible one-sided three-point estimate with monotone trimming (sign/3m0 clamp); interior knots use the FC weighted harmonic mean
interpolation.cross_check: agrees with scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolator to <= 1e-12 over [0.4, 2.0] (recorded in the S3 receipt)

validity_rules: 1. inputs finite, load_N >= 0, scale > 0, gamma > 0 (else code 1 invalid_input)

2. gamma == 1.0 exactly (else code 2): S0 gap 6 — the gamma axis is degenerate; the law maps gamma into Pi = F/(gamma*s*r0) but NO cell off gamma = 1.0 was ever measured, so the query refuses and says so
3. scale in [0.75, 2.0] (else code 3): the record's measured window; scales in {0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0} are measured nodes, others inside the interval are flagged scale_interpolated
4. load_N <= 2.0 N (else code 4): packet cap max_force_N=2.0, preregistered, never widened (record rows 2.5/3.0 N excluded, S0 gap 2)

5. Pi = load_N/(gamma*scale*r0): Pi in [0.4, 2.0] valid (code 0); Pi > 2.0 refused (code 5, outside the measured invariance window); 0 < Pi < 0.4 refused (code 6, unmeasured gap); Pi == 0 valid only at scale == 1.0 (code 7 otherwise)

6. every VALID answer carries named caveats: no self-intersection/ground-crossing refusal exists (S0 gap 3; within the valid window eta >= 0.111 so the apex stays above the rim plane); dynamics not excluded (S0 gap 7): quasistatic only
caveats: S0 gap 3: the law has NO self-intersection/self-contact variable; this query cannot refuse a self-intersecting configuration and the record does not name one
S0 gap 7: quasistatic only; dynamics/transients are not excluded in the record's excluded_phenomena and are out of scope here
static response map: passivity/energy-balance is NOT APPLICABLE; if dynamics enter later, energy balance/passivity of the relaxation and an inertia characterization would apply
monotonicity: eta strictly decreasing in Pi over the node table (measured); used as a STATIC CONSISTENCY check, not a conservation law
